The challenge in this Writ Petition is to the order passed by the respondent dated 20.08.2024 for the FY 2019-20 and to quash the same.

document_contents.quote: “taxpayer's (petitioner) has not produced valid documentary evidence. Hence, the taxpayer reply was not acceptable''

defects_argued.quote: Further, before passing the impugned order, the petitioner has not been afforded with any opportunity of personal hearing.
Therefore, this Court has no hesitation to hold that the impugned order passed by the respondent is a non-speaking order and suffers from violation of principles of natural justice.

outcome.quote: i) The impugned order passed by the respondent dated 20.08.2024 is set aside.
